anime.title: The Strongest Job Is Apparently Not a Hero or a Sage, but an Appraiser (Provisional)!
anime.originalTitle: 最強の職業は勇者でも賢者でもなく鑑定士（仮）らしいですよ？
anime.alternativeTitle: Saikyou no Shokugyou wa Yuusha demo Kenja demo Naku Kanteishi (Kari) Rashii desu yo

image.alt: Anime cover featuring the main characters

anime.synopsis: High school student Hibiki Manabe is transported to a fantasy world where he receives the job of Appraiser. He begins an adventure with new companions and discovers the potential of his unusual ability.
